title: Dodge Durango Engines by Year (1998–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Dodge Durango by year, 1998–2026: Magnum and PowerTech V6s and V8s, the 5.7 Hemi and hybrid, the Pentastar, the 392 and Hellcat.
intro: Dodge launched the Durango for 1998 on the Dakota's frame. The second generation ended in December 2008, so there was no 2010 model; the third generation arrived for 2011 on a unibody shared with the Jeep Grand Cherokee.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: First generation
intro: The 3.9, 5.2 and 5.9 Magnum engines, and the 4.7 PowerTech V8 from 2000.

generations.name: Second generation
intro: The 3.7 V6, the 4.7 V8 and the 5.7 Hemi, with a two-mode hybrid for 2009.

generations.name: Third generation
intro: The 3.6 Pentastar V6, the 5.7 Hemi, the 6.4 in the SRT and R/T 392, and the supercharged Hellcat.
